conflicts.description: The schematic's 4R and 6R location annotations imply four bulbs but print '(3) NO. 89'. Its 8R annotation specifies three playfield bulbs and one insert-panel bulb, while the operator's location drawing and VPW have four playfield candidates. No complete bank quantity is asserted; 8R remains unplaced. Resolution path: a machine owner photographs and counts the populated sockets and wiring on banks 4R, 6R and 8R, or a curator obtains a later factory schematic revision that reconciles the counts.
